---
title: "Introduction"
date: 2026-10-10
---
In my gap year, I plan to read through as much material as I can in homotopy theory to better prepare myself for graduate school. I began by finishing up Mosher and Tangora's *Cohomology Operations and Applications in Homotopy Theory*, which I had started reading last year for my undergraduate thesis. I have since started reading Douglas Ravenel's *Nilpotence and Periodicity in Stable Homotopy Theory*, also known as "The Orange Book". The spirit of all this reading isn't necessarily to rigorously learn every detail of the material, but rather get a solid conceptual understanding of the main ideas and results in the field. I'll generally be following the organization of the book, but I'll try to expand on ideas when possible.
